Cuts outstanding debt and may lower funding costs, affecting NIM and capital mix.
No premium; limits one-off P&L impact for issuer and holders.
Sets timing for cash outflow and cessation of interest expense.
Immediate reduction to interest expense from that date.
Signals ongoing optimization of capital and funding stack.

This is a mid-cycle liability management move aligning with Citi’s ongoing funding and capital optimization efforts. A larger catalyst would be broader debt redemption/issuance actions or quantified impacts on NIM, capital ratios, or borrowing costs.
